name: reqpilot
description: Source-faithful automotive requirements extraction, explicit decomposition, evidence review, and draft Matrix delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Read customer documents and build traceable requirement drafts.
interface.longDescription: Portable Agent skills and tools for document maps, stable SRC/REQ source items, authorized decomposition, evidence-linked review, and Excel drafts. Uses the same ReqPilotX domain contracts in an empty workspace or the existing workbench.
defaultPrompt: Read this customer document, preserve its structure and source items, and prepare a reviewable Matrix draft.
